title: openmui view document (*.view.omui.json)
description: A view as data (view-data-files §3). Generated from the registered components by `omui schema`; `omui check` applies the same rules and more (names in expressions, ids, types of constants).

id.description: An explicit id (spec S-8): never display text

expression.description: A CEL expression (registry/expr.toml): signals, models, properties, `event` in handlers

runtime_property.description: A property every node has (layout, look, motion, semantics)

bind.description: a signal, or a bindable interface property

additionalProperties.description: a string is an expression; anything else a constant
a string is an expression; anything else a constant

title.description: The header, also the accessible name. — default "" (bindable)

component.accordion.description: A section whose header is always shown and whose content shows while it is expanded.

actors.description: Whose actions it lists: actors whose names begin with this (`agent:` every agent, `agent:guide` one). — default "agent:"

limit.description: The records it shows, the newest. — default 50

link.description: Its first line says the person's agent link: waiting with its code, paired with whom, lost, expired. — default true

phrases.description: Its words in another language: a map from idle, waiting, paired, lost, expired, stopped, empty, undo, asked, refused to text ({code} and {agent} filled in).

component.actor_log.description: Who else acts here and what each did: the agent's link and its actions, each taken back from here while it is the last.

action.description: Its one action's label; none: no action. — default ""

message.description: With the title, its accessible name. — default ""

component.alert.description: A message in the page that needs attention: a tone, a title, the message, one action at most.

image.description: A picture by the runtime's image name (Runtime::images); none: the initials. — default ""

name.description: Whose: the initials and the colour come from it; the accessible name. — default "" (bindable)

component.avatar.description: Who: a picture, else initials on a colour of the name's own; an optional status dot.

count.description: A number shown instead of the text; negative: none. — default -1 (bindable)

dot.description: Only a dot: an unread mark; its name says what it marks. — default false

max.description: Past it, the count shows as max+ (99+). — default 99

text.description: The label, also the accessible name. — default "" (bindable)

component.badge.description: A short status or count beside something: a label, a number (max+ past max) or a dot.

label.description: The accessible name of the navigation. — default "Breadcrumb"

component.breadcrumb.description: Where one is, as the way down to it: each place a link, the last the current one.

icon.description: An icon token shown before the label. — default ""

text.description: The label, also the accessible name. — default "" (bindable)

verb.description: The verb activation invokes; its effect classifies `activate`. — default ""

interactive.description: The whole card can be activated (a link to what it shows). — default false

component.card.description: A surface holding one thing: a title, a subtitle and its content; activated as a whole when it is interactive.

component.checkbox.description: A checkable option; can be indeterminate.

removable.description: A tag: an × that removes it (the application takes it out). — default false

selectable.description: A filter: pressing turns it on and off (a toggle button). — default false

component.chip.description: A compact label: pressed, turned on and off as a filter, or removed as a tag.

component.color_picker.description: A colour chosen from a field and a hue strip, or the application's swatches.

columns.description: The fields shown, in order. — default []

headers.description: Their headers (else the fields' names). — default []

model.description: The model whose rows it shows. — default ""

multiple.description: Several rows chosen at once (Ctrl or Shift, Space). — default false

sort.description: The column sorted by: a field, ascending; -field, descending; empty: the model's order. — default "" (bindable)

widths.description: Each column's width in pixels; empty or * shares what is left. — default []

component.data_grid.description: A table of a model's rows: sorted by a column, rows chosen, read whole by agents.

min.description: The earliest date that may be chosen (ISO). — default ""

value.description: The date, ISO: 2026-11-02; empty: none yet. — default "" (bindable)

component.date_picker.description: A date chosen from a month's calendar.

component.dialog.description: A window over the application; modal by default.

modal.description: The page dimmed behind it, and kept from the person while it is open. — default true

side.description: The window's left (start) or right (end) edge. — default "end"

component.drawer.description: A sheet along the window's edge over the page, closed by Escape, a press outside or its ×.

alt.description: Text alternative; empty marks the image decorative (role none). — default ""

source.description: A path, a resource name or a data URI. — default ""

component.image.description: A raster or vector image; `alt` is its accessible name.

estimate.description: Estimated item height before measuring. — default 32

model.description: The model whose rows are the items. — default ""

component.list.description: A list of items, virtualised: only the visible items exist as nodes, the rest answer queries (S-7).

base_url.description: Where relative image sources and links resolve from (a directory or a URL). — default ""

extensions.description: `gfm`, `commonmark`, or extensions by name: tables, strikethrough, tasklists, autolinks, math, wikilinks, underline … — default []

label.description: The accessible name of the document (otherwise its first heading). — default ""

origin.description: Where the text came from; remote text (an LLM's, a web page's) is marked so on every node. — default "user_content"

source.description: The Markdown text. A value that extends the current one is appended (streaming). — default "" (bindable)

component.markdown.description: A Markdown document: rendered, semantic, streamable.

digits.description: Digits after the point shown. — default 0

suffix.description: A unit shown after the number (px, %, kg). — default ""

component.number_input.description: A number one types or steps, kept within min and max on its step.

around.description: How many pages are shown on each side of the current one. — default 1

label.description: The accessible name of the navigation. — default "Pages"

pages.description: How many pages there are. — default 1

component.pagination.description: Which page of many: previous, next, the pages around the current one, the first and the last.

arrow.description: A point toward what opened it. — default true

component.popover.description: Content beside what opened it, over the page; not modal: a press outside or Escape closes it.

component.progress.description: The progress of a task; indeterminate when value is negative.

group.description: The group's current value (bound to a signal). — default "" (bindable)

value.description: The value the group takes when this option is selected. — default ""

component.radio.description: One of a set of mutually exclusive options; the group is the radio_group role.

component.range_slider.description: A range chosen with two thumbs on one track, the low never past the high.

component.scroll_view.description: A viewport onto content larger than itself.

label.description: The accessible name of the group. — default ""

options.description: The choices' values; their labels from `labels` or the values. — default []

component.segmented.description: One of a few choices side by side, the chosen one raised.

options.description: Option values; labels come from `labels` or the values. — default []

component.select.description: Chooses one value from a popup list of options.

lines.description: Lines of text (shape text): the last one shorter. — default 3

component.skeleton.description: Where content is coming: its shape (lines, a picture, a block), busy until the content takes its place.

component.slider.description: Chooses a number in a range by dragging a thumb or stepping.

min.description: The least share either pane keeps. — default 0.15

ratio.description: The first pane's share of the room, 0–1. — default 0.5 (bindable)

vertical.description: One above the other. — default false

component.split_view.description: Two panes sharing their room, the share moved by a handle between them.

free.description: Any step may be gone to, not only those done. — default false

steps.description: The steps' names, in order. — default []

component.stepper.description: Where one is among steps: those done, the current one, those ahead.

component.tab.description: A tab of a tab list.

selected.description: The id of the selected tab. — default "" (bindable)

variant.description: line: the selected tab underlined; bar: the tabs on a capsule, the selected one in a lens that slides to it, stretching as it goes (a segmented control, a floating tab bar). — default "line"

component.tabs.description: A set of tabs selecting one panel.

color.description: Overrides the style's colour (theme token or #rrggbb). — default ""

max_lines.description: 0 is unlimited; beyond it the text ends with an ellipsis. — default 0

origin.description: Where the text came from (S-3). — default "app"

style.description: A text style token: display, title, heading, body, label, caption, code. — default "body"

text.description: The text; may be an expression. — default "" (bindable)

component.text.description: A run of styled text; wraps, aligns and truncates.

label.description: The accessible name when no visible label is associated. — default ""

component.text_box.description: A single- or multi-line text field with selection, clipboard and input methods.

hour12.description: Shown with AM and PM. — default false

step.description: Minutes a step moves, and the minutes kept on. — default 1

component.time_picker.description: A time of day, its hours and minutes each stepped or typed.

action.description: Its one action's label (Undo); none: no action. — default ""

duration.description: Seconds it stays; 0: until dismissed. — default 5

component.toast.description: A short message about what just happened, over a corner of the window; gone after a while, with one action at most.

component.tooltip.description: A short description shown while hovering or focusing an element.

expanded.description: The keys of the rows open. — default [] (bindable)

model.description: The model whose rows it shows: each row's `parent` field names its parent's key. — default ""

component.tree_view.description: A hierarchy from a model's rows, each a tree item opened, closed and chosen.
